_meta.note: Connector bible. AC and DC are different pins even inside combo plugs (e.g. CCS2 = Type2 AC + 2 DC pins).

connectors.name: CCS Combo 2
connectors.usedBy: All new IN/EU 4W (Nexon, BE.6, Atto 3, Ioniq 5 EU)
connectors.notes: India DC standard for 4W. If site lists only CCS2 and you have CCS2, native fit.

connectors.name: CCS Combo 1
connectors.notes: US legacy DC. NACS cars need NACS->CCS1 DC adapter (active, ~$200).

connectors.name: NACS / J3400 (Tesla)
connectors.usedBy: Tesla US, Ioniq 5 2025+ US, Ford/GM w/ adapter
connectors.notes: J3400 standardized 2024. Magic Dock sites serve CCS1 natively. Else CCS1 car needs CCS1->NACS adapter.

connectors.name: CHAdeMO
connectors.usedBy: Nissan Leaf, old Outlander, JP imports
connectors.notes: DYING in US/EU. No CHAdeMO->CCS DC adapter exists. Red-card routes that force CHAdeMO-only stops for CCS cars.

connectors.name: Type 2 / Mennekes / IEC 62196-2
connectors.notes: AC handshake. 3.3kW cars on 22kW posts still get 3.3kW.

connectors.name: J1772 / Type 1
connectors.notes: NACS cars use passive J1772->NACS adapter (cheap).

connectors.name: Type 6 / IS 17017-2-6 (LECCS)
connectors.usedBy: Ather, Ola, Chetak, iQube, Vida home/grid AC
connectors.notes: India light-EV AC standard. NOT compatible with Type 2 without adapter cable.

connectors.name: Bharat AC-001
connectors.usedBy: Old M&M Treo, Piaggio 3W, public slow posts
connectors.notes: Legacy IN standard. Cheap, ubiquitous in 3W stands.

connectors.name: Bharat DC-001
connectors.usedBy: Ather Grid DC (6kW derate), small 3W/2W DC
connectors.notes: 48V/72V low-voltage DC. A CCS2 car CANNOT use Bharat DC-001 — voltage mismatch + protocol. Hard incompatibility.

connectors.name: GB/T 20234 AC
connectors.notes: Physically similar to Type 2 but pinout/protocol differs. Adapter exists but rare outside CN.

connectors.name: GB/T 20234 DC
connectors.notes: ChaoJi successor planned. Export cars use CCS2 instead.

adapterMatrix.warning: Charge rate may cap ~150kW on some adapters. Buy OEM-approved only — melted pins are real.

adapterMatrix.adapter: CCS1 -> NACS (Tesla DC adapter) OR Magic Dock
adapterMatrix.cost: ~$175 / Magic Dock free at equipped sites
adapterMatrix.warning: Only at Tesla sites that allow non-Tesla (app auth). Pre-2024 cars may need software update.

rules.acVsDc: Never mix AC kW and DC kW in one number. A 22kW AC post gives a Tiago 3.3-7.2kW AC, NOT 22kW DC.
rules.peakVsSustained: Peak kW lasts minutes. Billing is per kWh + per min. powermatch.js integrates the curve, not the brochure.
rules.voltageClass: 48V Bharat DC-001 ≠ 400V CCS2. Filtering by connector name alone is insufficient — filter by voltage class too.
